question: Once I have activated scavenge, can an opponent stop the ability by removing the card from my graveyard in response?

expected.shortAnswer: No: exiling the card is part of the cost, so it is too late once the ability has been activated.
expected.answer: Exiling the creature card with scavenge is part of the cost of activating the scavenge ability. Once the ability is activated and the cost is paid, it’s too late to stop the ability from being activated by trying to remove the creature card from the graveyard.
